description: Header file defining the Analyzer class for build graph analysis in a build system, including method declarations and class structure.

classes.name: Analyzer
classes.description: Class providing analysis capabilities on a build graph, including querying affected items, filtering targets, and checking file modifications.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Performs analysis based on input JSON string and returns affected targets or items.

methods.name: GetAllAffectedItems
methods.description: Retrieves all items potentially affected by changes in specified source files.

methods.name: InvalidLabels
methods.description: Identifies labels that do not refer to valid objects in the build graph.

methods.name: TargetsFor
methods.description: Gets all targets associated with a set of labels.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a set of targets to include only relevant ones, recursively handling groups.

methods.name: FilterTarget
methods.description: Filters an individual target, adding results to the filtered set.

methods.name: ItemRefersToFile
methods.description: Checks if a build item refers to a specific source file.

methods.name: AddItemsDirectlyReferringToFile
methods.description: Adds items that directly refer to a given source file to the affected set.

methods.name: AddAllItemsReferringToItem
methods.description: Adds all items referring to a specific item to the affected set.

methods.name: WereMainGNFilesModified
methods.description: Checks if main GN files were modified based on a set of files.
